description: One period of depreciation that has already been written for an asset, and the Journal Entry that carries it. This is what makes a depreciation run idempotent: a period with a row here is never written twice.

fields.description: 1 for the first period of the asset's life, counting from the depreciation start date.
fields.label: Period

fields.description: The Journal Entry written for this period. Created as a draft — posting it is a separate, separately switched action.
fields.label: Journal Entry

name: Asset Depreciation Posting
